content.en:
This report surveys **~90 unique arXiv papers** related to Mixture of Experts (MoE) published or updated between February 10 and March 10, 2026. Each paper is annotated with **author affiliations** to reveal the institutional landscape of MoE research.

Notable highlights: **8 ICLR 2026 papers** (including 2 Orals), **4 CVPR 2026**, **1 ASPLOS 2026**, and NVIDIA's 88-page Megatron Core MoE training report.
content.zh:
本报告调研了 2026 年 2 月 10 日至 3 月 10 日期间 arXiv 上约 **90 篇独立 MoE 论文**，每篇均标注了**作者单位**，揭示 MoE 研究的机构版图。

亮点：**8 篇 ICLR 2026 论文**（含 2 篇 Oral）、**4 篇 CVPR 2026**、**1 篇 ASPLOS 2026**，以及 NVIDIA 的 88 页 Megatron Core MoE 训练技术报告。

title.en: Spotlight: ERC Loss (ICLR 2026 Oral) — Renmin University of China
title.zh: 重点关注：ERC Loss（ICLR 2026 Oral）— 中国人民大学

content.en: The Expert-Router Coupling (ERC) loss proposes a lightweight auxiliary loss that ensures router embeddings faithfully represent expert capabilities. Key innovation: operates on only n² activations (n = number of experts), making it independent of batch size. Demonstrated effectiveness on 3B–15B parameter MoE-LLMs trained on trillions of tokens.
content.zh: ERC Loss 提出了一种轻量辅助损失，确保路由嵌入忠实反映专家能力。核心创新：仅对 n² 个激活值操作（n 为专家数），计算量与 batch 大小无关。在 3B 到 15B 参数的 MoE-LLM 上验证了有效性。

content.en: MoE systems research is booming, driven by the deployment needs of DeepSeek-V3 and Qwen3. This period produced unprecedented volume on **distributed training**, **inference serving**, **hardware co-design**, and **fault tolerance**.

title.en: Spotlight: Megatron Core MoE (NVIDIA) — 88-page Technical Report
title.zh: 重点关注：Megatron Core MoE（NVIDIA）— 88 页技术报告

content.en: The most comprehensive open-source MoE training guide to date. Covers memory (fine-grained recomputation, offloading), communication (optimized dispatchers), computation (Grouped GEMM, CUDA Graphs), FP8/NVFP4, and long-context training. **1,233 TFLOPS/GPU on GB300** for DeepSeek-V3-685B.
content.zh: 目前最全面的开源 MoE 训练指南。涵盖内存、通信、计算优化，以及 FP8/NVFP4 和长上下文训练。在 GB300 上 DeepSeek-V3-685B 达到 **1233 TFLOPS/GPU**。

title.en: Spotlight: Optimal Sparsity (Tokyo Tech + Tohoku, ICLR 2026 Oral) & Super Experts (HKU, ICLR 2026)
title.zh: 重点关注：最优稀疏度（东工大+东北大学，ICLR 2026 Oral）& 超级专家（港大，ICLR 2026）

content.en: (1) **Optimal Sparsity** reveals that MoE sparsity influences reasoning and knowledge tasks differently, providing the first empirical scaling law coefficients for MoE. (2) **Super Experts** discovers that pruning just 3 out of 6,144 experts in Qwen3-30B causes substantial performance collapse — revealing hidden critical structure.
content.zh: (1) **最优稀疏度**揭示 MoE 稀疏度对推理和知识任务的影响截然不同，首次给出 MoE 经验缩放定律系数。(2) **超级专家**发现 Qwen3-30B 的 6144 个专家中仅剪掉 3 个就会导致性能崩溃，揭示了隐藏的关键结构。

title.zh: 机构版图

content.en: The MoE research ecosystem reveals clear institutional patterns across industry and academia.
content.zh: MoE 研究生态呈现出清晰的产学格局。

title.zh: 产业领军者

description.en: **NVIDIA** (3 papers: Megatron Core, Parallel Folding, Puzzle) dominates training infrastructure. **ByteDance** (4 papers: FP4, ReviveMoE, Grouter, AFD) is heavily invested in both training and serving. **Alibaba** (Expert Divergence, KBVQ-MoE, Routing Matters) focuses on architecture. **Huawei** (Semantic Parallelism), **Siemens** (Head CT), **Adobe** (SteerMoE), **IBM** (Analog-Digital), **Samsung** (Router Calibration), **Tencent** (Protein), and **YuanLab.ai** (Yuan3.0 Ultra) each contribute domain-specific work.
description.zh: **NVIDIA**（3篇：Megatron Core、Parallel Folding、Puzzle）主导训练基础设施。**字节跳动**（4篇：FP4、ReviveMoE、Grouter、AFD）在训练和推理上均有大量投入。**阿里巴巴**（Expert Divergence、KBVQ-MoE、Routing Matters）聚焦架构创新。**华为**（Semantic Parallelism）、**西门子**（Head CT）、**Adobe**（SteerMoE）、**IBM**（模拟计算）、**三星**（Router Calibration）、**腾讯**（蛋白质）和 **YuanLab.ai**（Yuan3.0 Ultra）各有垂直领域贡献。

description.en: **Peking University** (LAER-MoE ASPLOS, Grouter, Expressive Power), **Tsinghua** (MoESD NeurIPS, TiMi, MEGADance), **Fudan** (SD-MoE, MHA Forgetting), **Zhejiang** (ExpertWeaver, CoMoL), **SJTU** (MoDE-VLA), **Xi'an Jiaotong** (Quant Experts CVPR, Sim-to-Real), **Renmin** (ERC Loss ICLR Oral), **Beihang** (MoDES CVPR), **DUT** (UniMMAD CVPR). Chinese institutions are particularly strong in architecture design and vision applications.
